analyst.summary: Strides Pharma Science is a US/ex-US generics manufacturer trading cheaply (PE ~17x) for a pharma name, with recent results showing steady mid-teens revenue growth led by non-US markets while the US business stays soft and margins were squeezed this quarter by shipping/freight cost inflation. The business is fundamentally sound but not showing the growth acceleration that would justify a re-rating; we see it as a fairly valued Hold.
